text: 东门入线：先读林岚。
东门入线，缓步进展厅。
林岚常在窗前作画。
她常在窗前作画。
西门入线：先读周琴。
西门入线，缓步进展厅。
周琴常在灯下设色。
她常在灯下设色。
静默廊口，请把刚才的故事放在心里。
想着林岚，再穿过静默廊。
想着周琴，再穿过静默廊。
林岚，正在这幅肖像里。
她，正在这幅肖像里。
East gate: begin with Lin Lan.
East gate: enter slowly.
Lin Lan often painted by the window.
She often painted by the window.
West gate: begin with Zhou Qin.
West gate: enter slowly.
Zhou Qin mixed colors beneath the lamp.
She mixed colors beneath the lamp.
Silent porch: carry the recent story with you.
Think of Lin Lan, then cross the silent porch.
Think of Zhou Qin, then cross the silent porch.
Lin Lan is present in this portrait.
She is present in this portrait.
